Maya: Quick question - HelixCare wants a 10-day POC (7d burst + 3d reserved). Procurement says they will only issue a single PO and insist on exec signature on the MSA before releasing the PO. Can we accept PO-first?
Ira (Legal): Saw their MSA/DPA redlines. They added a blanket no-caching clause and asked for SOC2 evidence. As-written we shouldn't accept. Possible workaround: scoped Appendix that limits caching to ephemeral in-memory KV for the POC.
Jon (Presales): Pricing snapshot: burst-7d $7,500, reserved-3d-equivalent $2,100, est tokens 55k. If cache must be disabled, expect token usage +25%. We can offer 25k extra trial tokens instead of changing price.
Taylor (Finance): Single PO is fine if PO contains our legal name, remittance address, EIN, and billing contact. Also need two invoice line items for revenue mapping.
po-bot: PO check: missing vendor EIN and signature block. Recommended PO template: https://redwood.co/po-template. Attach W-9 or local tax form.
Maya: @Ira - can Legal allow PO-first if Sales Ops flags the PO and Security thumbs-up SOC2 addendum? Procurement wants to issue PO this week.
Ira (Legal): We can do PO-first for trial-only POCs if Sales Ops flags it as "PO-first - legal appendix pending" and Security approves the SOC2 scope. Draft appendix text: "For the duration of the HelixCare POC, Redwood may use ephemeral in-memory caching limited to KV entries retained no longer than ten (10) days; no persistent or external subprocessor caching is permitted. Appendix expires at POC termination."
Jon (Presales): I'll prepare two order-form options: (A) PO-first with Appendix + extra trial tokens, (B) exec-sign-first with original rates. Uploading now.
Taylor (Finance): On option A, Finance requires vendor fields filled on the PO. Also include GL codes on each line.
Maya: Plan: (1) upload two-option order form, (2) request Sales Ops expedited e-sign if exec required, (3) ping Security for SOC2 quick review. Back shortly. :thumbsup:
